text: Loads the specified labware with the given labels/slots; suitable pipettes and tip racks.
18 uL Q5 2x master mix into each of the 96 PCR wells.
1 uL colony template from each colony well into the matching PCR well, mixed ~3 times.
1 uL primer pair from each primer well into the matching PCR well; 20 uL final reaction.
Fresh tip per colony and per primer pair; no cross-contamination between samples.
Seal and thermocycling program (98 C 30 s; 30x [98 C 10 s, 60 C 30 s, 72 C 30 s]; 72 C 2 min; 4 C hold) recorded.
Physically sensible: 1 uL steps on the 20 uL pipette, sensible heights/flow, order of additions sensible.
Consistent with the task text and with the Slowpoke paper's automated colony PCR where the task does not fix details; nothing invented; comments/metadata accurate.
